paper_title: Knowing You Don't Know Learning When to Continue Search in Multi-round   RAG through Self-Practicing
caption: Ablation study on different Inner Monologue turns on HotPotQA. The green line represents the Naive Generation baseline, while the blue line shows the performance of SIM-RAGlite. The red line indicates the EM score using the ground-truth label as an Oracle Critic.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the performance of three different methods on the HotPotQA dataset as a function of the number of turns in the inner monologue, ranging from 0 to 6 turns on the linear x-axis labeled “Turns of Inner Monologue.” The y-axis, labeled “EM (%)”, uses a linear scale from 0 to 50, representing the Exact Match score as a percentage. The plot displays three lines: the red line with red ‘x’ markers represents SIM-RAG (Oracle Critic), the blue line with blue ‘x’ markers represents SIM-RAG (lite), and the green line with green ‘x’ markers represents Naive Gen. The red line starts at 20% EM at 0 turns and increases steadily to 47% EM at 6 turns. The blue line starts at approximately 15% EM at 0 turns and increases to 30% EM at 6 turns. The green line remains constant at 20% EM across all turns from 0 to 6.
